balls.text: Slower ball creates the top-edged pull. The Fizz runs towards the edge of the ring at midwicket but there's another fielder running in... neither of them take it in the end.
Pulled to long-on. Pace-on short ball was angling away
And Brar munches it over midwicket, brings up 200 with a 76-metre six. Was a slot ball at this stage, top-of-middle height, Brar made room, cleared the front leg and swung across the line

Appeal for caught behind. Ump takes a while before giving it out. He walked to the right before signalling. Jansen happy to walk. The bouncer went over fourth stump and Jansen wanted to pull it in front of square. He'd opened himself up too much and under-edged it
Beaten on the pull. Beaten for pace. Was a hard-length ball angling over the stumps
He goes short with pace on. Cramps Stoinis as he stepped back diagonally towards fourth stump and tried to pull. Spliced to long-off. They take the single
135ks Yorker on fourth nailed, a bit too late though. Jammed through point
Long-off was sent to deep square and Stoinis now drives over long-off. This was a proper slot ball around seventh stump, Stoinis was outside off and had effectively another free hit. 83-metre six

Stoinis plays the field and picks four on the free hit. Shuffled far outside and got deep in the crease for the slower ball into the pitch that rose to the waist. Pulled it from in front of the body, bottom hand came off, but the ball went safely through the unmanned square-leg area

Stoinis takes a step across, Mohit pushes the wide yorker further. It's close to the return crease though, let go. And the klaxon goes off! Mohit's got nothing behind the line and his strife continues.
Slow into the pitch, Stoinis got across, shaped to pull before letting it go. Was inside the wide line though

No one square of midwicket, so Stoinis went far across. Mohit went for the wide yorker but was still in Stoinis' line. Batter was too early on the flick, bottom hand came off. Deep midwicket ran across and got to it, tried to pull the ball in but palmed it onto the cushion
Mohit dropped Stoinis and now gets whacked over midwicket. Can't get away with the half-tracker, especially when it's rising under waist-height. Stoinis pulls it 95 metres far

Omarzai launches the pull but can't clear deep midwicket. 89ks googly, might've been too slow for the batter who pulled with the bat facing up. Replay shows that hit the inner-half of the bat, a touch too high too
Full and flat on middle, flicked to long-on
Goes back to a length ball on fifth, drives to deep cover
Fullish on leg, clipped to midwicket off the back foot

This time, Mohit takes it easily. At deep fine leg, took it around the chest and threw it into the ground in some disgust after missing the last ball. Was a very quick, flat ball from Kuldeep on the pads, Shreyas got on one leg for the Nataraja pull but top edged it. Set batter gone
Fluffed! Mohit got under the high ball, then tried to take it to the left. The ball popped in and straight out as he lost his balance and fell over the other side. Was a miscued sweep from Stoinis
Too straight and the full ball is helped fine. Easy four to bring up Shreyas' fifty
Stoinis goes across again. Mukesh continues to go full and wide, doesn't nail the yorker but Stoinis also cloths it. Whipped to long-on

Yorks du Plessis at long-off and goes for four. Might've hurt his finger on the way. Looked to take it with his right hand just above the grass. Got hit on the little finger while tumbling to the right. He's walking off. Was a wide yorker, Stoinis anticipated it, went across for a muscled drive
Defensive tactics now from DC. Mukesh goes wide yorker, it's past the tramline. Let go
Mukesh misses his length on the fuller side, line's too straight. Stoinis' stance is slightly open, so he doesn't have to move while picking up the ball over square leg for a 77-metre six
Ump calls wide this time. Bumper was angling away outside off and was left alone
Half-tracker rises thigh-high and Stoinis pulls it over midwicket. He made room and got followed, had ample time to swipe
Bumper. Wide not given, Stoinis reviews. It was over the stumps and he tried to ramp it over the keeper. His head's 1.92 metres tall, ball went 1.97 as it beat him. Wide given

Shreyas gets away again.... Ashutosh was back-tracking from cover, he didn't turn fully and tried to take the catch over his left shoulder, couldn't get in position properly. Was a hard-length ball that Shreyas tried to flay over cover but skied
Length on fourth, guided to short third
Pitched up on off from wide of the crease again, pushed to long-on

Thin edge, low catch for the keeper. Shashank looking to drive the 136ks length ball on the up through cover with power. He cleared the front leg but didn't have room for the open-faced vertical-bat shot. The Fizz releasing the ball from quite wide too

Stubbs is too early to catch the ball with one hand to the right and parries it, doesn't cost the team an extra as point came in. Was a length ball zipping through sixth, Shreyas looked to steer it, got it into the ground off the edge
Shreyas is beaten on the steer to third. The length ball landed around fourth and beat him for pace
Length ball lands around leg and finishes on fourth, guided to deep third

Nair signals six at long-on, almost got a really good boundary catch but his left leg touched the cushion. He was on one leg, his weight was falling to the left as he took the catch with both hands. From the replays, it looks like the foot didn't step on the cushion as he overbalanced on leg and pushed the ball back in. In the end, it will just be the single. Was a back of lengther outside off that was pulled off the splice.
Mohit does a Mark Wood, leaps left in the delivery stride to go wide of the crease. Misses his length, gets away with it. 132ks shin-high full toss is pushed softly to long-on
Yorker around fifth is jammed to cover for a quick single

Another bouncer nearly gets Shreyas. Kuldeep ran far from sort fine leg, only got fingertips on it while he dove. Deep square leg was coming in too, but Kuldeep called for it. This short ball didn't rise too high but got the top edge on the pull

Shreyas tries to hook it fine, ball's close to glove and it's been given caught behind! PBKS review. His head was outside off and he was falling away trying to hit it from down to up. Ultra-Edge shoes it went past the glove and the shoulder of the bat. Will be checked for wide, both on line and height. It's for height.. and it's four centimetres above head
Skiddy length ball over leg, clipped to deep midwicket's left
Driven to long-off's left for a quick couple. Was a 129ks fullish ball on fifth
Very full on fourth, 94ks, driven to cover's left. Ashutosh stops it past the ring with a slide
Decent recovery so far from Vipraj. Slightly short, on leg, worked to long-on
Dances down and slaps it to long-off. Along the ground
Shashank charges early, so Vipraj goes wide. 89ks, yorked Shashank, but he reached out while slashing. Got a top edge over short third
Close to a yorker. Down leg, flicked to deep midwicket
Shreyas will target him. Bluffs early by getting the back foot down leg before popping back to go inside out over extra. Vipraj got his length a touch too full and offered a bit of room
Back of length over leg, clipped off the back foot to deep midwicket
Deep point in place but Shreyas guides this squarer. Back of length around fifth stump, not a bad ball, square driven on the top of the bounce. From around thigh-high
Touch back of a length on leg, worked off the back foot through midwicket

Bottom hand comes off, he's skied it... and Faf runs from mid-off to take a good catch at mid-on.  Tumbled to the left and held on with both hands. The 135ks ball was on the fuller side of length, was coming in towards fourth. Looked more like the batter going for the straight drive too early rather than the ball sticking in the pitch.
Splices a pull, ball rolls to long-on's left. Shortish ball was angling in towards fourth

Premeditation doesn't work for Wadhera. He went across before the ball was released onto a back of a length outside off, he shaped for the regular paddle early before changing to the reverse. Was midway into the shot as he got beaten
Pitched up at the stumps, 90ks, flicked to long-on
Toes a pull, goes to deep square leg on the bounce. This was short and at the body, Shreyas too early on it.
Touch short, spinning down leg, Shreyas goes back and nudges it to the edge of the ring at midwicket
Expects the change in length, goes back and cuts nicely. Finds cover in the ring
Shreyas slugs it from outside off over wide long-on. Stock ball on a length, Shreyas' contact point was in front of the body, he was going with the spin too. Got it 86 metres far
Full on middle and leg, worked to long-on. 89ks, given air but too full to extract turn
On the fuller side outside off, guided through backward point
On a length at leg, worked to long-on. 137ks
Mohit goes wide of the crease but delivers a half-volley. It's just outside off and Shreyas doesn't have to move after going back in the crease. Drives over cover with ease. PBKS' hundred's up
Bouncer is slow off the pitch. Looked pace-on at release but that landed very short and finished around shoulder-height. Wadhera coiled back and cut to backward point
Dances down and gets beaten. The back-of-length ball angling into fourth beat the on-the-move punch aimed at mid-off
Pitched up on fourth, driven to long-off
Length ball on middle, goes back and punches it to long-on to keep strike
Quicker on leg, he goes for a wild swipe but gets it off the inside edge onto the pad and to the off side
Fuller around off, spinning away, he pushes forward and plays it off the outer half towards point
Fuller on leg, eased down to long-on
Quicker on leg, he goes back and nudges it through midwicket
Fuller on middle and leg, he comes forward and turns it with the spin through midwicket
The wrong'un coming in on a length, 88.2kph, whipped through midwicket
On middle, defensively pushed towards mid-off
Fuller on middle, swipes it fine but gets just two
Sweep gets Wadhera away. Tossed up full on off, he gets across and hits it very fine. Manvanth, the sub, puts in a valiant effort after getting to his left from backward square leg but in vain
Quicker on middle, clipped through midwicket
Iyerrrr goesss highheerrrrr! Floated full outside off, he gets across, on a knee and slog-sweeps it well over deep midwicket
Fuller on leg, he comes forward to clip it away but misses

Nigam with a perfect riposte again. After being hit for a boundary that. This is also Prabhsimran's own doing though. He goes across to play the scoop. Nigam fires it full on off, so he gets an inside edge onto the off stump. A missed chance that for Prabh
Inside out and almost goes the distance! Looped up wide outside off, Prabhsimran leans into it, get down on his back knee and swings it with the spin over cover
Very full on off, dug out to cover
Spins away from a length outside off, he goes back and punches it to deep cover
Wrong'un almost sneaks through Prabhsimran. He squeezes it off the inner edge towards short third
Fuller outside off, he presses forward and pushes it through cover
Slows it down outside off, Iyer gets across and pats it towards short third. Has one look at his partner and sprints to the other end
Wrong'un on a length outside off, he goes back and finds backward point with the cut
Quicker one on a length on off, he goes back and keeps it out to off, 93.6kph
Goes back to the length ball on off and turns it through midwicket
Flat-batted away over long-on! Kuldeep bowls a length ball across him at 95.7kph, Prabhsimran stays deep in the crease and heaves it straight over
Floated full outside off, he clears it front leg and slogs it wide of long-on. Oh dear, he has overstepped
Fuller outside off, the wrong'un, he looks to drive it through off but gets a thick inside edge through midwicket. Hands on head for Nigam, costly start but a wicket in there

Just evades cover and Iyer gets going with four. He backs away early to make room, Nigam floats it full outside off. Iyer has to reach out and does so but gets the desired result past du Plessis' dive
Fuller on middle, he comes forward and blocks. Fired in at 90.7kph
Shortish and outside off, spinning away, Iyer goes back and cuts it to backward point

Nigam has the last laugh, thanks in big measure to Stubbs! Slips in the googly again on middle and leg, Inglis charges down the track with no intent of going big actually. Looks to tickle it away but perhaps doesn't pick the googly. He is beaten down the legside and Stubbs does the rest. Easy movement to his left, pouches it and breaks the stumps. A quick cameo from Inglis ends
Thick edge, beats short third. The quicker googly next up, he goes back to punch it but gets a streaky boundary instead
Half-tracker, despatched! Drops it short on middle, enough time for Inglis to go back, get low and pull it over deep midwicket
Dances down and goes over. Much better from Prabhsimran. Holds his shape as he charges down at a length ball and lofts it over mid-off
Very full around off, goes across to scoop this time but it comes onto his front foot and lobs towards the keeper

Shuffles, goes back and finds the gap. Prabhsimran moves across to play the scoop. Mohit bowls it on a length outside off and he realises he cannot get under it for the scoop. So he goes back and steers it betweenshort third and backward point
Length ball outside off, punched defensively to cover, 135.9kph
Fuller on middle, punched through midwicket
Length ball on middle and leg, he looks to whip it across but gets a thick inside edge onto the back thigh
Drops a touch return catch! Another offcutter around leg, Inglis hangs back and punches it straight back. Mustafizur sticks his left hand out but it does not stick
Quicker ball on leg, flicked through forward square leg for a brace, 137.7kph

Huuugggeee! Flick of a wrist and that is out of here. A gentle hit-me ball on the pad from Mustafizur, Inglis obliges. Clears his front leg, whips it well over deep backward square leg. There was a man there but he got right under the offcutter to send it sailing
Goes back and across to slash the length ball angling away from him through point
Length ball on middle from wide of the crease, he looks to steer it fine through third but gets an inside edge onto the back leg
My word. All timing and placement. Length ball on middle, Prabhsimran times his push straight down the ground with a straight blade. Enough to beat du Plessis diving across from mid-off

Dropped! Inglis gets a life thanks to his daredevilry. He charges down at a Mukesh length ball and slaps it straight down. Mohit gets around from mid-on, dives and gets a hand but it bursts through him
Length ball on middle, clipped through midwicket for an easy two
On a length on off, punched straight back to Mukesh
Puts that away in style. Length ball angling in down leg, Inglis pulls it well past short fine leg
Length ball on off and middle, he swipes across the line and it just evades Mustafizur running back from midwicket

Edged and down? Nair at slip, dives full-stretch to his right but it lands just short. Getting a taste of what it could be like in Test cricket. Mukesh bowled it on a length, Prabh got squared up and a thick edge. Gets away this time
Length ball on leg, whipped away through backward square leg to get going with a brace

A strange innings from Arya ends, thanks to a well-judged catch by Stubbs. Arya looked in some hurry today, and was often losing his shape. Mustafizur lands it on a short length around off, 136kph, Arya is hurried into the pull. Gets a top edge and flies behind. Stubbs has his eyes on the ball as he backtracks and pouches it with a tumble
Outside off on a length, he looks to flay it away but misses
Length ball just outside off, punched towards backward point, who half-stops it and concedes two
Length ball on leg, clipped through backward square leg
Length ball slanting away on a length, he strides forward and drives it to cover
Once again an inswinger on a length around off, punched to mid-off. Good start from Mukesh
Edged and four! This is the outswinger on a length around off, Arya is squared up a touch. Hangs back and pokes his bat and gfets it well away from slip
Swinging in from a length outside leg, he misses the flick and is high on the front leg
Angling away on a length, no feet movement as he slashes at it, beaten and called wide
Slightly fuller, around the good-length region on middle, pushed back to the bowler
Similar ball around off and middle, if anything, this one's shorter. Punched off the back foot towards mid-off
A hint of shape in as he begins with a length ball around off, Arya gets behind it and pushes defensively towards mid-off

Swept. Almost out of the ground. Grand finish from Rizvi! Stoinis went for another leg-stump yorker, missed the length. Bowled it full. Rizvi got on one knee, swiped low and clean. Whippy, wristy and middled
Leg-stump yorker. Stubbs slides back in the crease and is happy to flick it along the ground to deep midwicket
Slower one, slashed to deep point. Didn't middle it. Was a full ball well outside off
Make it 7. Full ball speared in goes down leg, past the attempted paddle

Whoa! Stubbs has reverse pulled it fine with the game on the line. Was a short ball over leg, it rose about waist-height, bounce has been low on this pitch, but that was a heck of a premeditated shot.
Gets away with a slot ball on middle. Was the attempted yorker. Rizvi cleared the front leg and went for the lofted off-drive. Opened himself up too much, got it along the ground to long-off
Stubbs gets low to a low fully outside off. Plops it to long-on. 135ks
First IPL fifty for Rizvi. He raises his bat and gets applauded. Badani's all smiles. Was a length ball in the channel square driven towards cover
Heaved over backward square while falling over! Rizvi was walking across, got a knuckle ball into the pitch that he helped over from around rib-height for a 71-metre six
Length just outside leg but Stubbs was taking guard outside leg too. Nudged off the knee-roll to midwicket
Rizvi turns the over in DC's favour with a pull over midwicket. Touch back of length around top-of-stump height, the batter was deep in the crease and cleared the infield easily
Omarzai runs back towards mid-on to keep it to one. Was a hard-length ball that Stubbs tried to flick. Ball came on too quickly and spooned up. No one in the ring at midwicket or mid-on though
Short 130ks ball doesn't rise too much but seemed skiddy. Rizvi chops it with the bat facing down, to point
Perfect yorker but Rizvi's managed to flick it to short fine's left. It was right on the crease, Rizvi slid his front leg back in the crease and helped it with the closing bat face.
Near yorker on off, pace on, drilled to long-on
Pulls the shortish 128ks ball from around waist-height to deep midwicket
Stubbs double bluffs, starts going leg side but brings the back foot into regular position and punishes the low, wide full toss. Drives it along the ground through cover
Beaten on the pull. The length ball went past the right leg as Stubbs made room. Went below bat
Makes room early and Brar goes well outside off. Rizvi just about manages to bunt the low full toss to deep point while reaching out
Given a bit of air ad it's toned over wide long-on. Stock ball was a touch too full and angling in on middle and leg, Rizvi cleared the front leg and drove it with a full folllow-through
93ks full ball on leg, Stubbs had made room early. Whipped to long-on
Smart two through square leg. Stubbs clipped the length ball at his pads just past the ring, the fielder had to run in from the deep, which took time
Just four off the over. Asking rate back up to 12. Short ball at chest-height around fourth, 137ks, pulled to deep midwicket.
Length on fourth, punched to cover. 137ks. Great over so far for DC
Arshdeep sees Rizvi walking across, bowls it slow and full to stop him momentarily. Rizvi then flicks it along the ground to deep midwicket
Back of length on leg, clipped from knee-roll height to deep fine leg
He has a sighter. Taps the length ball on fourth to cover
Pitched up on fourth, punched to long-off

Nair goes too far across and is bowled trying to sweep. Brar roars. Was a stock ball that landed close to the crease and knocked out leg stump. Nair couldn't fully get on one knee, just couldn't get low enough. Pace - 95ks
Makes ample room and flashes the full ball on leg stump to long-off. On the bounce
A bit of turn, Nair had to adjust his pull as he was walking across. Gets it to deep midwicket. Ball was a touch short and going towards fifth
Down leg, the fullish ball goes past the sweep
Nair's taking guard on fourth, so Brar goes close to the tramline. Nair, however, waited for the length ball to go past him and then cut to beat deep point on the left
Length on middle, clipped towards midwicket. Brar runs and slides to keep it to one
Flat and shortish, angling in towards the stumps, pulled to deep backward square on the bounce
Doesn't matter as Rizvi clears deep square. Jansen grimly collects his cap. He followed Rizvi as the batter made room, got it into the pitch. But it didn't rise too high and was pulled with ease

Looks to pick it up fine, the length ball beats him and hits him around the groin. Ball falls forward and they scamper through. As Jansen was ready to end his day with the ball, the klaxon goes off. Foot's on the line, nothing behind
Makes room and cuts it from over leg stump. Finds deep cover
Cramped for room but Nair goes through with the pull. On the bounce to long-on
Slot ball, doesn't matter that it's slow as it goes straight on. Nair made room and timed the pants off the lofted off-drive. Mid-off was in too. 76 metres far it goes
Slower one into the pitch, Rizvi was across to off, was square-on and deep in the crease while trying to pull it fine. Gloved it to the keeper's left
136ks yorker on leg, Nair stays still and short-arm whips it along the ground to deep midwicket
Another edge, this goes to deep third on the bounce. Shreyas runs left and stops it. Was a short and wide ball, Nair charged and top edged the cut
Length on fifth, driven to cover

Short fine brought in and Rizvi middles the paddle. Incredible shot to a shortish ball. Got on one knee and lifted it  from chest-height while he was lunging. Didn't have room to free his arms but still connected
Rizvi dances down early, so Omarzai bumps him. Rizvi was halfway into the pull while abandoning the shot, the ball took the inside edge and sailed fine. Too fine deep fine leg
Makes room and drives while being beside the line of the fullish ball following him to long-on. 133ks
Jansen loses it in the lights at deep fine leg, ball lands a few metres in front. Was a bouncer around chest-height that Rizvi pulled. Was late on it
Touch back of length over off, defended towards cover off the back foot
Gets on one knee and creams the full, wide ball to deep point
Nair goes across early to paddle, misses. The fullish ball angles in and hits him flush on the pad

Inglis goes up in appeal for caught behind. "I heard a noise," he says. Bowler not as confident but PBKS will review. Looks like a big gap between bat and ball as Nair got beaten on the cut. No Ultra-Edge needed. Was a short ball angling in towards fifth. Bounced more than Nair expected, went above the bat
Backs away and tries to open up cover as there was no dep fielder between point and long-on. The length ball got big on the slashy drive and Nair ended up chunking it
Length on fifth, guided to deep third
Bumper from around the wicket angles down leg. Rizvi shapes for the pull but lets it go
Down leg again, swept fine of short fine leg. Short fine was in for that ball and the line allowed Nair to whack it to his right. Four fours to finish. PBKS now 51% on win predictor
Too short, sits up and doesn't turn. Nair pulls along the ground through midwicket and finishes with an easy swivel
Goes across to get inside the line and sweep again, goes finer this time. To short fine's left. Picked it off a length from around fourth stump. No turn for the legbreak again
Slog swept, this was on the up to a length ball too, but Nair was behind it rather than having to fetch it. Got it low through square leg
Length down leg, glanced softly and fine. Short fine charges back to keep it to one
That'll increase now as Atal's top edged a slog sweep to long-on. He tried to hit it off a length as it angled away outside off. Ball didn't turn but Atal wasn't to the pitch which cost him
Length ball on middle, punched down to long-on
Slower length ball from around the stumps, he nicks it but it goes on the bounce to the keeper
Top edge and it sails well over deep backward square leg. Short ball from over the wicket, he goes deep in the crease and pulls it
Inglis shells a skier! Cross-seamer from Stoinis, full in length outside off, Atal looks to go big but skies it in the air. Inglis circles under it and never settles under it
Around the wicket, bowls a low full toss around off, Atal backs away and drives it towards cover, where Brar gets a hand to it. In fact it will go down as a drop as Brar took time to get low down
Full and straight on off, driven down to long-on
Lands it on a length on off, defensively chipped back towards the bowler
Spinning away from a length on middle, he punches it to long-on
Floated full on middle, driven back to the bowler
Flatter on leg, clipped through midwicket
Dragged down on leg, he pulls it to deep backward square leg
Flatter and slanting away, punched to long-off
Yorker outside off, squeezes it out to the off side and hares to the other end, 143.5kph
Fuller on middle and leg, he looks to tuck it away but gets it off the pad through midwicket, 143.2kph, sees no fielder in that region and sprints back for two
First six for Atal in IPL cricket! Short and angling in, he swings his bat across the line and helps it wayyyy over fine leg
Full and slanting away, driven to deep cover
Short ball angled in, gets a little big on him, 136.8kph. He drags the pull through square leg
Full on leg, kept out to midwicket
Flatter and on a length around off, goes back and punches it past the non-striker to get going. Five runs and a wicket off Brar's second
Fired outside off on a length, he goes back to slap but misses

Soft, soft dismissal and Brar does a thigh-five! Flatter trajectory on a length outside off, it bounces a touch more. Du Plessis goes back to cut it over backward point but slices it straight to Arya. A start goes to waste again, DC lose two in quick time
Fuller on middle, hit down to long-on
Quicker on middle, once again goes deep in the crease to nudge it through forward square leg
Slows it down, lands it on a length on middle, he nudges it through midwicket for a brace
Angling away on a length, he looks to glide it through third but is beaten
Full and outside off, driven to cover
Underway with a free swing of the bat! Shortish ball down leg, Nair gets inside the line of it and picks it up over fine leg

A harmless delivery, a well-judged catch do it for Rahul. Jansen dishes out the offcutter on a length on middle and leg, Rahul perhaps did not pick the change in pace. Goes for the lofted drive over mid-off but only sliced it. Shashank runs to his right, leaps and takes it
Valiant effort from Wadhera! A bouncer from Jansen, Rahul clobbered the pull. He almost hit it too well to deep backward square leg, who dives to his right but fails to reach it
Length ball on leg, clipped through backward square leg
Gorgeous! Floated up on middle, Rahul charges down and hits it straight into the sightscreen to bring up the fifty stand
Fired full on leg, flicked to deep midwicket
Once again backs away early but drives it aerially towards cover
Use of the feet from Faf. Flatter on middle, he dances down by making room and swats it across the line to play it wide of mid-on
Tossed up on a length on off, he goes back to punch it to long-off
Backs away early, Brar follows him with a fired in length ball, clipped through midwicket
Backs away early, he follows Rahul with a full ball which is driven back to the bowler only, 15 off the over
Full and on middle, a hint of tail back in, he looks to flick but gets a thick inside edge onto the back leg
Gift, accepted. Omarzai sprays this length ball on Rahul's pads, and he nonchalantly whips it away from his presence through fine leg
On the up, away from cover. Length ball outside off again, Rahul gets back and across, punches the drive away from the man in the ring and well away from sweeper rushing to his right
Length ball on middle, clipped through square leg
High, above and over! Length ball angling in on middle and leg, 132.8kph, du Plessis plays the pick-up shot well over deep square leg on the shorter side, against the wind
Slapped over cover. Arshdeep overcompensates for the previous balls. Doles out plenty of width outside off. Rahul stands tall and hits it over short cover
Launched over midwicket. Full and swinging in on leg, he flicks, not off the meat, but it is enough
Length ball slanting away, slapped to cover
Full on off, he leans forward and opens his face to play it to backward point
Length ball on leg, turned around the corner
